notes: A tall white rounded card over a soft pastel meadow illustration. It has the tavily by Nebius logo, 'Welcome' and 'Log in to continue to Tavily', then an email field, a 'Verify you are human' checkbox and a black pill Continue button. After a sign-up link and an OR divider come full-width Google, GitHub, LinkedIn and Microsoft buttons. LinkedIn is shown but is not in the sign_in_methods enum, so it is omitted from the array. The requesting app and the openid and offline_access scopes are not mentioned.
